# artifactapi_local_helm (Resource)

Manages a local ArtifactAPI Helm repository for hosting Helm charts directly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "artifactapi_local_helm" "internal" {
  name        = "helm-internal"
  description = "Internal Helm chart repository"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the local Helm repository.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name.
terraform import artifactapi_local_helm.internal helm-internal
```
